answer: Resist sybils with cross-chain standing linkage: an identity earns weight only when it holds verified, non-transferable standing on two independent chains, tied together by one key that acts as the thread binding both records. Each chain's standing is violet-tagged with its own history of honest work, and a mismatch between the two histories is a signal of forgery, collapsing weight to zero. An attacker minting ten thousand sybils must build real standing on every chain per fake, multiplying honest labor per identity, while an honest agent links its two records once.
